title: World Mental Health Report: Transforming Mental Health for All
description: WHO's landmark call to reshape mental-health environments, services, and rights, and to close the vast global treatment gap.

title: mhGAP Intervention Guide, Version 2.0
description: The Mental Health Gap Action Programme guide for managing priority mental, neurological, and substance-use conditions in non-specialist settings.

title: Out of the Shadows: Making Mental Health a Global Priority
description: The report from the first global mental-health conference making the development and economic case for investment.

title: Depression and Other Common Mental Disorders: Global Estimates
description: WHO's global prevalence estimates showing depression as a leading cause of disability worldwide.

title: The Lancet Commission on Global Mental Health and Sustainable Development
description: A major commission reframing mental health as a global public good central to the SDGs, with a focus on scaling care.

title: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support in Emergencies (IASC Guidelines)
description: The inter-agency guidelines coordinating mental-health and psychosocial support in humanitarian settings.

title: Task-Sharing for Mental Health Care in Low-Resource Settings
description: Evidence and guidance on delivering psychological interventions through trained non-specialist community workers.

title: Adolescent Mental Health and Wellbeing
description: 'On My Mind'—the State of the World's Children focused on promoting, protecting, and caring for children's mental health.

title: The Economic Case for Investing in Mental Health
description: Return-on-investment analysis showing that scaling up treatment for depression and anxiety yields large economic gains.

title: Comprehensive Mental Health Action Plan 2013-2030
description: The updated global action plan setting targets for leadership, community care, promotion, and information systems.

title: Suicide Worldwide in 2019: Global Health Estimates
description: WHO estimates on the global burden of suicide and the LIVE LIFE strategies for prevention.

title: Wellbeing and Happiness: The World Happiness Report 2024
description: The annual ranking and analysis of subjective wellbeing across countries and the life circumstances that shape it.

title: Barriers and facilitators to implementation of evidence-based task-sharing mental health interventions in low- and middle-income countries: a systematic review using implementation science frameworks
description: Thirty-seven papers across 28 task-sharing interventions, coded into a framework of 37 constructs. The finding worth acting on: the facilitators sit in the things a programme can change (the intervention, the providers), while the barriers sit in the things it cannot (the mental health system, stigma).

title: Task-sharing psychosocial interventions for the prevention of common mental disorders in the perinatal period in low- and middle-income countries: A systematic review and meta-analysis
description: 23 trials, 24,442 participants. Task-shared psychosocial prevention roughly halves the incidence of perinatal depression (RR 0.51), does not shift anxiety, and the effect decays at follow-up — which is the part most summaries leave out.

title: Expanding mental health services in low- and middle-income countries: A task-shifting framework for delivery of comprehensive, collaborative, and community-based care
description: A service-design framework that separates workers by skill rather than by cadre: psychoeducation, community psychotherapeutic counselling, and primary medical care as three distinct roles. Useful when costing a programme rather than describing one.

title: Evaluating implementation research outcomes for a task-sharing mental health intervention: A systematic review of the Friendship Bench
description: Seven studies on Zimbabwe's Friendship Bench, the most-cited lay-worker mental health model in Africa. Acceptable and feasible; the limits are an unreliable referral system behind it and no answer for severe illness.

title: Transdiagnostic Psychological Interventions for Symptoms of Common Mental Disorders Delivered by Non‐Specialist Providers in Low‐ and Middle‐Income Countries: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
description: 21 transdiagnostic interventions. Moderate reductions in distress, anxiety and depression at post-treatment (g about -0.6), smaller but surviving at 13 to 26 weeks. Argues against building one programme per diagnosis in a setting that has no specialists.

title: A global scoping review of task shifting and sharing interventions to improve the mental health of people living with HIV/AIDS
description: Scopes a decade of lay-worker psychosocial support for people living with HIV. Notes what is consistently under-reported in this literature: how lay health workers were selected, paid and supervised.
